name: Barbell Back Squat
cues: Set feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, toes angled outward 15-30 degrees.
Brace core deeply with 360-degree intra-abdominal pressure.
Initiate by breaking at knees and hips simultaneously.
Descend until hip crease is below the top of the patella (parallel or below).
Drive through midfoot, keeping chest proud and knees tracking over toes.
commonMistakes: Knee valgus (knees caving inward during ascent)
Excessive forward torso collapse or 'good-morning' squatting
Heels lifting off the platform

name: Barbell Bench Press
cues: Establish 5 points of contact: head, upper back, glutes, left foot, right foot.
Retract and depress scapulae to create a stable pressing foundation.
Grip bar with thumbs wrapped, wrists stacked neutral directly above elbows.
Lower bar under control to lower sternum/nipple line with elbows at ~45-70 degrees.
Press explosively back up and slightly backward over the glenohumeral joint.
commonMistakes: Excessive elbow flaring to 90 degrees putting high shear on shoulders
Bouncing the bar off the rib cage
Lifting glutes off the bench during heavy effort

name: Conventional Deadlift
cues: Stance hip-width apart, bar over midfoot (approx 1 inch from shins).
Hinge at hips to grip bar just outside shins without moving the bar.
Pull chest tall, pull slack out of the bar, lock lats down into back pockets.
Drive floor away through midfoot, extending knees and hips synchronously.
Lock out hips tall with glute contraction without hyperextending lumbar spine.
commonMistakes: Rounding lumbar spine under heavy loading
Bar drifting away from the body during ascent
Jerking the bar before taking the slack out

name: Standing Overhead Press (OHP)
cues: Grip bar just outside shoulder width with vertical forearms.
Squeeze glutes and brace core to establish a rigid pillar.
Pull chin back slightly to clear the bar path as you press vertically.
Once bar clears forehead, press through and lock out directly over cervical spine.
Shrug traps gently at the top for full upward rotation of scapulae.
commonMistakes: Excessive lumbar hyperextension (leaning back into a faux-incline press)
Elbows flaring outward instead of tracking slightly in front of bar in rack position
Failing to lock out overhead

name: Pull-Up
cues: Pronated grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
Start from a dead hang with engaged scapular depression.
Pull elbows down and back toward your hip pockets.
Drive chin above bar without kipping or swinging legs.
Lower with a controlled 2-3 second eccentric down to full extension.
commonMistakes: Kipping or relying on momentum
Partial range of motion (failing to reach full dead hang at bottom)
Reaching forward with chin instead of pulling chest toward bar

name: Bent-Over Barbell Row
cues: Hinge torso forward to ~45 degrees or parallel to ground with neutral spine.
Grip bar with hands shoulder-width apart.
Pull bar toward lower rib cage / belly button, leading with elbows.
Squeeze shoulder blades together at the apex.
Lower under control without bouncing torso.
commonMistakes: Using excessive body English / jerking torso upward to heave weight
Rounding spine at bottom of pull
Pulling too high to upper chest and shrugging shoulders

name: Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
cues: Stand tall, soft bend in knees (keep knee angle fixed throughout).
Push hips backward as if reaching for a wall behind you.
Keep bar in continuous contact with thighs/shins as you descend.
Descend until hamstrings reach peak stretch (typically just below knees).
Drive hips forward and squeeze glutes to return to standing.
commonMistakes: Squatting the weight down rather than hinging at hips
Allowing bar to drift away from legs
Rounding lower back to artificially gain range of motion

name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
cues: Elevate rear foot on bench or box behind you (~12-18 inches high).
Position front foot so your front knee stays roughly over midfoot/ankle.
Descend straight down until rear knee approaches floor.
Maintain slight forward torso lean to load target glute and quad.
Push through front midfoot/heel to rise.
commonMistakes: Placing front foot too close causing extreme heel lift
Collapsing knee inward on descent
Arching lower back excessively

name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
cues: Set bench at 30-45 degree incline angle.
Kick dumbbells up to shoulder position and retract shoulder blades.
Press dumbbells up in a slight arc, bringing them closer at top without clanking.
Lower under control until you feel a deep, comfortable stretch in upper chest.
commonMistakes: Bench angle too steep (>45 deg) turning lift into a shoulder press
Excessive arching of lower back off the bench
Letting dumbbells flare too wide at the bottom

name: Neutral Grip Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cues: Sit upright with back supported or stand tall with engaged core.
Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other (neutral grip).
Press dumbbells directly upward over shoulders.
Lower under control with elbows tracking in the scapular plane (45 degrees forward).
commonMistakes: Flaring elbows wide
Leaning back excessively on seated bench

name: Cable Lat Pulldown
cues: Secure thighs snugly under knee pads.
Grip wide bar with overhand grip.
Slightly lean back (10-15 degrees), depress scapulae, and pull bar to upper chest.
Squeeze lats firmly at bottom before smoothly returning to full overhead stretch.
commonMistakes: Swinging torso excessively backward using momentum
Pulling bar behind the neck (high cervical/shoulder impingement risk)
Not allowing arms to fully extend at the top

name: Seated Cable Row
cues: Sit tall with slight knee flexion and feet firmly on footplates.
Hinge slightly forward at hip for a good stretch, then return to neutral upright torso.
Drive elbows back past torso, pulling attachment into lower abdomen.
Pinch shoulder blades together for 1 full second.
commonMistakes: Excessive rocking / swinging back and forth
Shrugging shoulders into ears
Rounding spine during the stretch

name: 45-Degree Incline Leg Press
cues: Sit firmly back against seat with lower back and sacrum flat against pad.
Place feet shoulder-width on sled platform.
Unlock safety handles and lower weight until knees reach ~90 degrees.
Press smoothly through whole foot without locking knees out harshly at top.
commonMistakes: Letting lower back curl/peel off the backrest at the bottom (pelvic tilt)
Violently snapping/hyperextending knees at the top
Using hands on knees to push the weight

name: Lying Hamstring Leg Curl
cues: Position pad just above Achilles tendon/heels.
Keep hips pressed down into bench throughout movement.
Curl legs upward towards glutes, feeling deep hamstring contraction.
Lower under control over 2-3 seconds.
commonMistakes: Lifting hips off bench to use hip flexors/momentum
Jerking the weight quickly
Incomplete range of motion

name: Leg Extension Machine
cues: Align machine pivot point directly with knee joints.
Pad should sit comfortably on lower shins just above ankles.
Extend legs until knees are straight, pausing for 1 second at full contraction.
Lower slowly under control.
commonMistakes: Kicking the weight up with jerky speed
Seat position misaligned with knee axis
Shortening range of motion

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
cues: Stand with slight forward torso lean (10-15 degrees).
Slight bend in elbows, raise dumbbells in scapular plane (slightly forward of torso).
Lead with elbows up to shoulder level (parallel to floor).
Control the descent over 2-3 seconds.
commonMistakes: Using heavy momentum and swinging hips
Shrugging traps before lifting arms
Raising hands higher than elbows

name: Incline Dumbbell Bicep Curl
cues: Set bench to 45-60 degree incline.
Let arms hang straight down for full passive bicep stretch.
Curl dumbbells up while keeping elbows pinned in place behind torso.
Supinate wrists (turn palms toward ceiling) as you curl.
Lower slowly to full bottom stretch.
commonMistakes: Swinging elbows forward to engage front delts
Cutting bottom stretch short

name: Cable Tricep Rope Pushdown
cues: Stand with knees slightly bent, torso leaning forward 10 degrees.
Pin elbows tightly by your sides.
Push rope down and spread ends apart at bottom for peak contraction.
Return slowly until forearms are slightly above parallel with floor.
commonMistakes: Allowing elbows to flare or drift forward and backward
Using body weight to push down rather than triceps

name: Hanging Knee/Leg Raise
cues: Hang from pull-up bar with overhand grip and engaged shoulders.
Roll pelvis upward and curl knees/toes toward chest.
Focus on flexing spine with abdominal contraction rather than just swinging hip flexors.
Lower under control without swinging.
commonMistakes: Swinging body like a pendulum
Only moving hip flexors without posterior pelvic tilt

name: RKC Core Plank
cues: Elbows directly under shoulders, forearms parallel.
Lock knees, squeeze glutes, and tuck pelvis (posterior pelvic tilt).
Actively pull elbows toward toes to generate maximal isometric tension.
Breathe steadily while maintaining abdominal brace.
commonMistakes: Sagging lower back / anterior pelvic tilt
Piking hips up in the air
Holding breath

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
cues: Hold dumbbell vertically against chest with both palms cupping the top head.
Feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned slightly out.
Squat deeply between knees, keeping chest tall and elbows inside knees.
Push floor away through midfoot to stand.
commonMistakes: Holding dumbbell too far away from chest
Rounding upper back

name: Standard Push-Up
cues: Hands placed slightly wider than shoulders, fingers spread.
Body in rigid plank from head to heels.
Lower until chest grazes floor with elbows at 45 degrees.
Press fully up to lockout, pushing through upper back.
commonMistakes: Sagging hips
Flaring elbows 90 degrees
Half-reps not touching chest

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
cues: One knee and hand on flat bench (or standing staggered hinge).
Flat back parallel to floor.
Pull dumbbell up towards hip pocket, keeping elbow close to side.
Lower to a full, controlled lat stretch at the bottom.
commonMistakes: Twisting torso excessively to heave the dumbbell
Pulling to shoulder instead of hip

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
cues: Hold dumbbells in front of thighs with neutral grip.
Push hips backward while keeping dumbbells tight to shins.
Feel deep hamstring stretch just below knee level.
Squeeze glutes to stand tall.
commonMistakes: Rounding spine
Squatting down instead of hinging hips back

name: Resistance Band Pull-Apart
cues: Hold band at shoulder height with arms straight.
Pull band apart until it touches chest by squeezing shoulder blades.
Hold 1 second, then control back to start.
commonMistakes: Shrugging shoulders upward
Bending elbows excessively

name: Resistance Band Squat
cues: Stand on loop band with feet shoulder-width, bring top of band over shoulders in rack position.
Squat to parallel or below against progressive elastic tension.
Drive up forcefully to full standing lockout.
commonMistakes: Letting band pull chest forward
Knees collapsing inward

name: Trap Bar (Hex Bar) Deadlift
cues: Step inside hex bar, feet hip-to-shoulder width.
Hinge and bend knees to grasp neutral handles.
Set chest high, brace core, and drive through midfoot.
Stand upright to full hip extension without hyperextending.
commonMistakes: Rounding upper back
Jerking arms at initiation

name: Cable Face Pull
cues: Set cable pulley at eye height with rope attachment.
Grip with thumbs pointing back towards you.
Pull rope towards forehead/bridge of nose while externally rotating shoulders.
Finish with knuckles facing ceiling and elbows high and wide.
commonMistakes: Pulling to neck/chest without external rotation
Leaning backward with momentum
